summary: CRT-style file-handle close. Validates that handle a1 is below uNumber (0x008D4A20) and that the open bit (bit 0) at the per-handle slot in dword_8D4920 (0x008D4920) is set; if valid, enters the per-handle critical section, closes via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting and returns its result. Otherwise writes 9 to the TLS errno slot and 0 to the TLS doserrno slot and returns -1.

operations.description: Proceed to close only if a1 < uNumber and the byte at dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) + 4 has bit 0 set (handle is open).
Enter the per-handle critical section via CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit(a1).
Close the OS handle via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting(a1); capture its return value in v1.
Leave the per-handle critical section via FileCriticalSectionLeave(a1).
Return v1 (the close result) on the valid-handle path.
On the invalid-handle path, write 9 to the TLS errno slot obtained from TLSOffsetGetter().
On the invalid-handle path, write 0 to the TLS doserrno slot obtained from TLSOffsetGetter_afd8().

unresolved: The 9 written to the TLS errno slot is conventionally EBADF, but the errno enum is not evidenced in this packet.
The 36-byte stride of the per-handle slot in dword_8D4920 is a derived constant from the array index expression; its structure is not further evidenced.
